final_guidance: ACCEPT_WITH_CHANGES. The diagnosis-to-fix mapping is sound, the two transforms are correctly scoped to the confirmed root causes, and the no-new-LLM-call / no-gate-relaxation discipline is right. The exploratory transforms give real empirical confidence both blockers are mechanically fixable. The plan WILL run decomposition-through-proposal-in-hand provided the end-to-end verification (steps 7-9) is executed against the actual recorded Grok output, not a synthetic stand-in. The only genuine risk to the 'do not relax the gate' invariant is component_measurability being satisfied by BA-generated import contracts — close that with the anti-masking test before implementing. Provenance-empty auto contracts and the missing-parent-dir new-file case are the two concrete edge cases most likely to bite during GREEN. Proceed to TDD with the required test additions front-loaded; Fable review afterward should focus on whether closure ever rescues a component the LLM left genuinely unmeasurable.
implementation_warnings: Placement before finalize_snapshot_identity means the snapshot hash now depends on closure output. Any nondeterminism (set iteration, dict ordering, unsorted pair derivation, unsorted supporting_edge_ids) will destabilize hashes across runs. Sort everything that enters the snapshot, including the derived component pairs and per-contract edge id lists, not just the top-level contract list.

component_measurability becoming satisfiable by BA-generated contracts is the subtle hazard in this plan. It is acceptable for import-edge-backed components but must be inert for components without real edges — verify the no-edge path explicitly, since a regression here silently lowers the bar for the whole gate.

Change 2 broadens the proposer from 'edit existing file' to 'create arbitrary non-protected new file'. Ensure the protected/boundary set used by _single_target_path is authoritative and evaluated BEFORE any transport call (the rejects-protected-missing-target test must assert FakeTransport.requests stays empty), so new-file support cannot be used to write into read-only areas.

End-to-end (steps 8-9): a now-passing, more-measurable Project Model may reorder intake ranking. Do not assume docs/index.md remains the top handoff. Verify against the ACTUAL recorded Grok output that the top single-target handoff after gate+freshness pass is materializable — otherwise you prove the two unit blockers fixed without proving the real decomposition-through-proposal path closes.

Confirm the recorded fixture used in step 7 is the exact failing second-live Grok raw output, so the replay genuinely demonstrates the previously-failing run now gates green rather than a hand-shaped lookalike.
required_changes_before_implementation: Add an explicit anti-masking guarantee for component_measurability. Auto-closure now attaches BA-generated import contracts to components, which will satisfy the contract/check/gap sub-check. This is legitimate ONLY for components that actually own real cross-component import edges. Before implementing, define and test that a component with no owned import edges and no LLM-provided checks/gaps STILL fails measurability — closure must not become a universal rescue that papers over weak leaf-component decomposition. This is the one place the plan risks crossing Opus's 'do not relax the gate' line.

Pin down auto-contract provenance behavior. The plan falls back edge-provenance -> from-component-provenance, but says nothing about the case where neither exists. Decide explicitly: if an auto contract would have empty provenance_refs and the gate requires provenance, the edge must be left for the gate to reject (consistent with the existing 'if an edge cannot map, leave it' rule) rather than emitting an unprovenanced auto contract. Encode this as a test, not an assumption inherited from the one exploratory snapshot.

Make the auto-contract shape requirements explicit assertions rather than relying on the single exploratory transform passing. The exploratory run passing with zero violations on ONE snapshot does not prove near_neighbor_alternative_ids=[] and the chosen field set satisfy the gate generally. Add direct assertions on each gate sub-check the auto contract must satisfy (contract_references endpoints, edge_coverage, provenance, near-neighbor optionality).
simplifications: Use the SAME gate helper that enumerates owned cross-component import edges as the single source of truth for both closure and the edge_coverage check, so the two can never diverge. The plan already gestures at this ('derived by the same gate helper') — make it a hard constraint: closure consumes the gate's edge enumeration, it does not reimplement it.

Avoid reaching into multiple private `_`-prefixed gate internals from arena.project_decomposer_ai. If closure needs _edge_supports_contract / _component_pairs_for_import_edge, promote a single shared internal entrypoint rather than coupling the decomposer to several gate privates; this keeps the 'mechanical and consistent with the gate' invariant in one place.

Change 2 is already appropriately narrow; resist any temptation to generalize the new-file path. Keep it strictly single-target, boundary-checked-before-transport, with validate_unified_diff + git apply --check as the only proof.
tests_to_add_or_adjust: Add: genuinely-unmeasurable component (no owned import edges, no checks/gaps) still fails the gate after closure — guards the component_measurability masking risk.
Add: auto contract with no available provenance (neither edge nor from-component) results in gate rejection, not a silently-closed snapshot.

Add (diff proposer): new-file target whose parent directory does not yet exist (nested path like docs/sub/index.md) — confirm parent-inside-repo / not-a-file logic and git apply --check behavior; the plan only covers docs/index.md where docs/ exists.

Strengthen test_contract_closure_is_idempotent_and_stable to also assert no contract.auto.<edge-id> collides with any model-provided contract id, and that running closure on an already-closed snapshot is a no-op (not just hash-stable across rebuild).

In test_recorded_live_shaped_output...: assert the raw model-output sidecar is byte-for-byte unchanged (audit preservation) AND that dropped invalid model contract IDs are removed from every component contract_ids (no dangling references).
